countries_assessed_and_reasons_for_exclu.Ireland: Too mature AI ecosystem (high adoption, extensive government initiatives).
countries_assessed_and_reasons_for_exclu.New Zealand: Too mature AI ecosystem (high adoption, advanced strategies, 'second wave' of adoption).
countries_assessed_and_reasons_for_exclu.Singapore: Too mature AI ecosystem (high adoption, substantial investment, sophisticated governance frameworks, leading in Asia).
countries_assessed_and_reasons_for_exclu.Hong Kong: Too mature AI ecosystem (high adoption across all sectors, significant investment, advanced infrastructure and governance).

evaluation_process: Systematically evaluated English-speaking countries with GDP between $200B and $1T USD nominal (2023-2024) against criteria for 'just starting to incorporate AI'. Prioritized direct outputs from advisory agents and detailed web search findings for AI adoption status. Re-evaluated countries with nuanced adoption profiles to ensure strict adherence to 'just starting' criterion. Resolved GDP and English official language data inconsistencies to ensure reliable selection.
